rows.note: Use this as the everyday noun for displaying an image with a projector.

example.english: The projection of the film is so clear that even people in the back can see it.
example.traditional: 部戲嘅投影好清，坐後排都睇得清楚。
example.jyutping: bou6 hei3 ge3 tau4 jing2 hou2 cing1 zo6 hau6 paai4 dou1 tai2 dak1 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this for a forecast or estimate of a future result, especially one based on data.

example.english: Based on the latest data, the sales projection for this quarter will be higher than last quarter.
example.traditional: 根據最新數據，呢個季度嘅銷售預測會比上季高。
example.jyutping: gan1 geoi3 zeoi3 san1 sou3 geoi3 ni1 go3 gwai3 dou6 ge3 siu1 sau6 jyu6 cak1 wui5 bei2 soeng5 gwai3 gou1

rows.jyutping: dat6 ceot1 lai4 ge3 bou6 fan6
rows.note: Use this for a physical part or surface that sticks out, such as a ledge on a cliff.

example.english: When hiking, watch out for the projection sticking out of the rock face, or you will hit your head.
example.traditional: 行山嗰陣，小心石壁上面嗰啲凸出嚟嘅部分，唔好撞親個頭。
example.jyutping: haang4 saan1 go2 zan6 siu2 sam1 sek6 bik1 soeng6 min6 go2 di1 dat6 ceot1 lai4 ge3 bou6 fan6 m4 hou2 zong6 can1 go3 tau4
